quality_limitations: An initial PP8 concurrent synthetic access-code fixture passed 7/8: one response identified the correct value in reasoning but refused to repeat it. The explicitly fictional catalog fixture passed 8/8.

PP8 MTP3 with low reasoning effort passed 17/20 broader objective checks. One reversal changed letter case and two answers omitted the reasoning delimiter, leaving final content empty. Raw token inspection confirmed model output rather than delimiter loss in parsing.
